about: Bill of materials for the physical AI player (camera gantry + magnet hand, and the optional SO-101 arm). One entry per part, ordered or not. table/tests/bom_test.py checks it against the manual and the goal doc: every part is used by a step that exists, every Amazon link in those docs is listed here, removed parts stay out of the manual, and the cart totals add up.

statuses.cart: in a cart, about to be ordered
statuses.saved: in Amazon's Save for later: waits on the M1 magnet test
statuses.check: needed; probably on hand, buy only if missing
statuses.to-print: printed on the CR-6 Max before it becomes the gantry
statuses.list-only: saved in the Amazon list, not in the cart (a fallback)
statuses.removed: was in a cart, taken out; kept here so nobody re-adds it by accident

amazon.note: Only the M1 test kit is in the cart (magnet, diodes); the steel discs were dropped for #10 zinc washers from Home Depot; everything else is in Save for later until the stack test passes 19/20

home-depot.note: via Instacart; that cart also holds a copper tee ($23.09) that is not part of this build, so the cart reads $82.05 (over the $3.13 needed for Instacart's $15 restaurant credit)

items.name: Canon EOS Rebel T5i with 18–55 mm lens
items.role: the eyes: photographs the bed from above

items.name: Creality CR-6 Max 3D printer
items.role: prints the Step 3 parts, then becomes the gantry (and, on the magnet route, the hand)

items.name: PLA+ filament
items.role: the printed parts in Step 3: magnet swivel, deck box, discard chute, privacy wall

items.name: Gonine LP-E8 dummy battery / ACK-E8 AC kit
items.role: mains power for the camera; Canon recommends the AC kit for tethered shooting; M1 uses the table's existing fixed camera, so this waits

items.name: SCOVEE 10 ft Mini-USB camera cable for Canon Rebel
items.role: camera to the Mac (the T5i's port is Mini-B); skip if the camera's own cable turns up

items.name: CAMVATE 1/4"-20 mini ball head (2-pack)
items.role: aims the camera straight down (one used, one spare)

items.name: Heschen 24 V holding electromagnet HS-P20x15
items.role: the hand: picks up steel-sleeved cards; about 0.25 A / 3 W at 24 V

items.name: totalElement 1/2" steel discs, no adhesive (250-pack)
items.role: thinner than the #10 washers; dropped 2026-10-05 (they arrive 10 Oct) — reorder for the real deck if the washers make the stack too tall

items.name: Everbilt #10 zinc flat washers (100-pack)
items.role: one behind each of the AI's cards, inside the sleeve (zinc-plated steel, about 1/2" across, ~1.2 mm); measure card_t before printing the deck box

items.name: 1N4007 rectifier diodes (125-pack)
items.role: one across the magnet's coil to absorb the switch-off spike

items.name: RSHTECH 7-port powered USB hub (USB-C and USB-A)
items.role: the Mac has only USB-C; camera and printer cables end in USB-A. A USB-C to USB-A adapter you already own does the same for the magnet route, so this can go

items.name: ForgeMotion Labs SO-101 follower arm kit with printed frame
items.role: the arm route's hand: 6 × STS3215 servos, driver board, 12 V 5 A supply, frame; needs a USB-C cable

items.name: innomaker 1080p 32 × 32 mm UVC wrist camera
items.role: close-up view from the arm's wrist

items.name: KarlKers 20 A inline 12–24 V switch
items.role: hard power cut for the arm (the printer has its own switch)

items.name: Everbilt aluminium angle 1" × 3 ft × 1/8"
items.role: camera bracket (~6") and magnet bracket (~3")

items.name: Everbilt 1/4"-20 × 1" zinc hex bolt
items.role: ball head to the camera bracket; the magnet swivel's axle

items.name: Everbilt 1/4"-20 wing nut (4-pack)
items.role: sets the swivel's drag by hand

items.name: Everbilt nylon spacer 1/2" × 1" (0.257" bore)
items.role: cut to ~6 mm: a low-friction washer between the swivel and its bracket

items.name: Everbilt 1/4" rubber flat washers (10-pack)
items.role: vibration damping under the ball head; the tap station's grippy foot

items.name: Everbilt spring assortment kit (84-pack)
items.role: one compression spring under the swivel's wing nut for drag; four more under the deck box's follower plate

items.name: Scotch Extreme double-sided mounting tape 1" × 48"
items.role: brackets to the beam and the carriage without drilling the printer

items.name: Zip ties
items.role: back up the tape; tidy cables

items.name: Everbilt M3 × 6 mm zinc pan head machine screws (4-pack)
items.role: fixes the magnet (M3 thread in its back) to the printed swivel

items.name: 22 AWG two-core wire, about 1 m
items.role: extends the magnet's leads to the part-fan connector

items.name: Commercial Electric 4" heat-shrink tubing assortment (8-pack)
items.role: insulates the diode's legs and the lead splices

items.name: Kapton (polyimide) tape
items.role: insulates under the bed clips (the CR-6 USB fault) and covers the cable's +5 V pin

items.name: Micro-USB cable for the printer (came with it)
items.role: printer to the Mac, with its +5 V pin taped over

items.name: USB-C to USB-A adapter
items.role: replaces the hub on the magnet route

items.name: Card sleeves, inner and outer, for the AI's deck
items.role: a steel disc sits between the inner and outer sleeve, behind the card

items.name: Non-slip shelf liner, cut to the bed
items.role: stops the moving bed from sliding the AI's cards around

items.name: Multimeter
items.role: measures the printer's USB shell against the Mac's ground before the first plug-in

items.name: Printed magnet swivel
items.role: holds the magnet and the swivel bolt, turning in the bracket for tapping by arc

items.name: Printed deck box with a one-card exit slot
items.role: holds the AI's shuffled deck face-up and covered; the magnet slides the top card out through a slot one card thick, so the card below can't follow

items.name: Printed deck box follower plate
items.role: rides on four springs inside the deck box, keeping the top card against the lips at the exit slot

items.name: Printed discard chute
items.role: off the bed's edge into a tray: graveyard and exile take no bed space

items.name: Printed hand rack
items.role: the AI's hand, up to seven cards in a staircase along the bed's back edge; its fence hides the faces from the person

items.name: Printed sleeving jig tray
items.role: holds an inner-sleeved card face-down while its washer is placed

items.name: Printed sleeving jig bridge
items.role: its hole drops every washer at the card's centre

items.name: Printed lead clip
items.role: holds the magnet's leads with a loop of slack so the swivel can turn

items.name: Printed privacy wall
items.role: hides the AI's face-up hand zone from the person
items.reason: the hand rack's fence hides the AI's hand (2026-10-05)

items.name: Ferrous receptive vinyl sheet 11 × 17"
items.role: fallback card insert if the discs lift two cards at once; about 13 g per card

items.name: MG90S micro servos (2-pack)
items.reason: tapping is done by an arc move on the swivel; back on only if that fails (it is in the Amazon list)

items.name: SANSUN 12 V 2 A power supply
items.reason: the magnet runs on the printer's 24 V

items.name: Nano V3.0 USB-C (3-pack)
items.reason: the printer's part-fan output switches the magnet (M106/M107)

items.name: MOSFET switch modules (11-pack)
items.reason: the printer's part-fan output switches the magnet
